title: Giftlift
description: A vanilla-style PvP game with unique items and abilities
body:
## 🎁 Giftlift
Giftlift is a strategic and objective based team PvP game in development. Here, the way you approach the game can be the difference between winning and losing.

The aim of the game is to have the most gifts by the end of the game. Need more gifts? Lift them from the enemy team's stockpile! But don't let them lift your gifts. That would not be ideal for the win.

🚣 Use boats to transport gifts and make quick getaways.

🗣️ Work with your team to attack the enemy base or defend your gifts.

💣 Build your own loadout to suit your playstyle. Play risky, be deceiving, or play your own way.

🛡️ Defend your gifts by building defences and holding entrances and exits.

⚔️ Attack the enemy and steal gifts by breaching defences or eliminating everybody.

https://playgiftlift.com/

## Requirements
- Be playing on version 1.21.11
- Have the mod [OpenBoatUtils](https://modrinth.com/mod/openboatutils) installed
